title: The Sands of Time are Sinking
lyrics_original: The sands of time are sinking,
The summer morn I've sighed for-
Dark, dark hath been the midnight,
O Christ, He is the Fountain,
The deep, sweet Well of Love!
The streams of earth I've tasted
There the Red Rose of Sharon
He fills the air of Heaven
The King there in His beauty,
It were a well spent journey,
The Lamb with His fair army,
He brings a poor vile sinner
I'll have no Rock beside Him
The Bride eyes not her garment,
I will not gaze at glory
But on my King of Grace.
Not at the crown He giveth
The Lamb is all the glory

bible_verses.english: I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth have passed away, and the sea is no more. I saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband. I heard a loud voice out of heaven saying, “Behold, God’s dwelling is with people, and he will dwell with them, and they will be his people, and God himself will be with them as their God. He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain, any more. The first things have passed away.”
We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it, as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns, and the morning star arises in your hearts:
but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never be thirsty again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, You are the deep, sweet well of eternal love, and my heart longs for You. When the days grow dark or earthly comforts fail to satisfy, remind me that Your glorious dawn is near. Teach me to drink deeply from Your presence today and fix my hope on the joy of Immanuel’s land. Keep my eyes on You until the morning breaks and all sorrow flees away. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: Life’s earthly hours are fleeting, but our ultimate hope rests in the bright, eternal morning of Christ’s presence. Though we face seasons of darkness and incomplete satisfactions here below, Jesus is the inexhaustible fountain of living love who truly satisfies our souls. As time slips away, this hymn gently invites us to lift our eyes to Immanuel’s land, anchoring our heart’s deep longings in the Savior who makes all things new.
